latestVersion.changelog:
Online to Video AI — Initial Release

- Launches a cloud-powered tool to convert URLs, PDFs, TXT, and DOCX files (up to 200MB) into shareable 1080p videos within 1-2 minutes.
- Supports content creators and marketers in generating explainer videos, voiceovers, and social-ready video files from online articles and documents.
- Seamless setup: automatic token retrieval, session management, and clear feedback (“Connecting…”, “Ready!”).
- Exposes commands for uploading, exporting, tracking credits, and checking status, with robust error handling and guided workflows.
- Supports multiple input formats and export options, with clear instructions, quickstart guidance, and user-friendly messaging throughout the workflow.
